name: Data Quality Rules
description: Produces a data quality rule set defining completeness, validity, consistency, accuracy, and uniqueness rules for each field in a dataset. Includes threshold values and alert conditions for automated monitoring. Use when the user asks to define data quality checks, set up data validation rules, create a data quality framework, or establish thresholds for data integrity monitoring. Do NOT use for spreadsheet-level input validation (use data-validation-setup), ETL pipeline design (use etl-pipeline-design), or data cleaning operations (use data-cleaning-protocol).
